name: process_email_to_invoice
description: Process a customer email to create an invoice in Odoo. Extracts customer info, service details, and amount from the email, creates the customer and invoice in Odoo, and optionally sends an invoice email. Use this when you receive a service request email that needs to be invoiced.

email_content.description: Full email content including frontmatter (from, subject, body)

send_invoice_email.description: Whether to send the invoice email to the customer (default: true)
